info.a: Full oral talks are longer presentations with time for questions. Rapid-fire talks are short summaries of a single finding.

info.q: How do I ask a question?
info.a: Open a talk in the program and tap “Ask a question.” The moderator reads questions from the form during Q&A.
Questions about the retreat? Contact the MRFA organizing committee.
